description: This file defines the PermissionDao interface, which extends a generic DAO interface for handling Permission entities. It declares methods for listing permissions, retrieving permissions by ID, filtering by groups, and listing permissions based on criteria.

classes.name: PermissionDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to Permission entities, extending generic DAO functionalities.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all permissions.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission object by its unique ID.

methods.name: getPermissionsListByGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of permissions filtered by a set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Lists permissions based on specified criteria encapsulated in PermissionCriteria.
